mentions.name: Kintoun
mentions.description: Kintoun is an iOS client for Cloudflare, allowing users to manage their Cloudflare services from an iPhone. Version 2.0 has just been released.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’ve just released v2.0 of Kintoun (https://kintoun.app), an iOS client for Cloudflare that I’ve been building for quite a while now.
